name.description: Name of the image. Required for create operations.

imagetype.description: Type of image. Possible values: 1 - (default) icon; 2 - background image. This property is constant (cannot be changed after creation) and is required for create operations.

image.description: Base64 encoded image. The maximum size of the encoded image is 1 MB. Maximum size can be adjusted by changing the ZBX_MAX_IMAGE_SIZE constant value. Supported image formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP. Required for create operations.
